description: This file is a shell script containing a series of tests for Git checkout functionality, including checking branch states, upstream configurations, handling ambiguous branch names, and file conflicts during checkout operations.

methods.name: test_branch
methods.description: Checks if the current HEAD matches a specified branch.

methods.name: test_branch_upstream
methods.description: Verifies that the branch's upstream configuration matches expected remote and branch.

methods.name: status_uno_is_clean
methods.description: Ensures that the working directory is clean with no uncommitted changes.
